changes.proposed_text: Full credit for the norm-identity criterion may use any fully derived algebraically equivalent weighted complex-exponential, cosine or sine formula, provided the retained-label argument and absence of branch-overlap cross terms are justified. An unexplained formula alone may receive partial credit; omission of sine normal form alone is not an error.
changes.reason: The exact question requests an exact formula, not a prescribed normal form.
changes.mathematical_equivalence: sum p_lambda |exp(i phi_lambda)-exp(i chi)|^2 = 2-2 sum p_lambda cos(phi_lambda-chi) = 4 sum p_lambda sin^2((phi_lambda-chi)/2), where p_lambda=|c_lambda|^2 and sum p_lambda=1.
